description: The right to a free copy of the claim file (every document, record and guideline the insurer relied on) for employer, government employer and Marketplace plans, with the regulation text verbatim and a short request letter with blanks to fill. For other plan types it says no rule for this is held here. Example questions: how do I get the records my insurer used to deny me; can I see my claim file; request the documents behind my denial.

plan_type.description: Set only if the letter or the person says so: erisa = Employer plan (private employer, covered by ERISA); gov_employer = Government employer plan (state, county, city or school district); aca_individual = Individual or Marketplace (ACA) plan; medicare_advantage = Medicare Advantage plan; medicaid_managed = Medicaid managed care plan; medicaid_ffs = Medicaid (state agency, no managed care plan); original_medicare = Original Medicare; fehb = Federal employee plan (FEHB)

name: get_my_claim_file
title: Get my claim file
